text:
maria: Heads up — after the sidecar 1.4.2 rollout onto GPU node pool, remote_write queues ballooned and Cortex started returning 504s. Dashboard shows write latency spikes and label cardinality up ~4x. Logs attached below.

chris: Oof. Any relabel_config changes in this rollout?

maria: Yes, we added a labelmap to bring pod labels into metrics to help debugging workload routing. Snippet from the new config: 
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(.+)
```
This will copy all pod labels as metrics labels. That exploded cardinality on many jobs.

ankita: That explains it. Quick mitigation: revert labelmap or limit it with a whitelist regex. e.g. replace with: 
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(app|component|role)$
```
Should reduce new label dimensions.

sam: Can we roll the sidecar back on the GPU pool while we push the config change? Remote_write queue is causing backpressure across clusters. @deploy-bot can you coordinate?

deploy-bot: rollback triggered for prometheus-scraper-sidecar/gpu-pool -> rolling back to 1.4.1. Watching pods. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

prom-bot: ALERT: RemoteWriteQueueLengthHigh firing (cluster: gpu-pool, job: prometheus-scraper) — queue_length=1420, queued_bytes=1.8GB

maria: Thanks. I'll prepare the whitelist relabel patch and upload to the prometheus config k8s secret. Quick patch I'm applying now: 
```yaml
# replace global labelmap with a tighter whitelist
relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(app|component)$
  - action: drop
    regex: ".*"
    source_labels: [__name__]
    # keep only prometheus metrics we care about for remote_write (example)
```
Applying to the gpu-scraper subset first, then roll through.

chris: Good call. After patch, let's watch remote_write success rate and SLOs. Add an alert mute for the noisy alert.

ankita: Also add a preventative note to release docs: "avoid broad labelmap on high-cardinality exporters", and run a small cardinality estimate job during rollout next time.

sam: Rolling back sidecar seems to have reduced immediate pressure. Still see elevated queue length but trending down. Will keep monitoring. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll follow up with a short postmortem and the relabel diff. Thanks everyone.
